import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;

    static long expo(long x, long a) {
        if (a == 0) return 1;
        long ans = expo(x, a / 2);
        ans = (ans * ans) % MOD;
        if (a % 2 == 1) {
            ans = (ans * x) % MOD;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long p = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();

        if (k == 0) {
            System.out.println(expo(p, p - 1));
        } else if (k == 1) {
            System.out.println(expo(p, p));
        } else {
            long at = k;
            long fator = 1;
            while (at != 1) {
                at = (at * k) % p;
                fator++;
            }
            long expoente = (p - 1) / fator;
            System.out.println(expo(p, expoente));
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
